query:
WITH "(?i).*DOMAIN ADMINS.*" AS group_pattern
MATCH (g:Group)<-[:MemberOf*1..]-(u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WHERE g.name =~ group_pattern
RETURN g.name AS Group, u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, c.name AS Computer, fo.profilepaths AS ProfilePaths, fo.findingids AS FindingIds, fo.matchcount AS Matches
ORDER BY Group, User, Category, ArtifactType
name: Profilehound - Privileged Group Artifact Inventory
description: Lists artifact inventory for users reachable from a privileged group pattern.
